title: Venetian Bronze 2 Swing Arm Towel Rail - 12.5-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass - Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels within reach without crowding your vanity—this swing arm towel rail folds neatly against the wall when you’re done in Venetian Bronze, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty, it’s crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday bathroom use.

  • Venetian Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Pairs elegantly with matching Waverly Place hardware for refined warmth
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Choose a coordinated look—part of the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place transitional bath accessories
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives

Specs

  • Product type: 2 swing arm towel rail (double arm towel bar)
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Material: Solid brass
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 12.5 in x 7.1 in x 7 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 5.6 lb
  • Included items: Towel rail and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Waverly Place collection.
